notes: Breadboard orientation: in the image the rows f-j are at the top and a-e at the bottom, so the button straddles the centre gap with legs in columns 4 and 6 (4b.f/4t.e and 6b.f/6t.e). The lower rails (next to rows a-e) are mapped to tp (+, red line) and tn (-, black line).
Rail hole numbers (tp.2, tn.2, tp.4, tn.9) are approximated from the image; any hole on the same rail is electrically equivalent.

Pushbutton legs: side 1 (1.l/1.r) is column 4, which goes to 5V via the orange wire; side 2 (2.l/2.r) is column 6, which goes to pin 2 (teal wire) and to the 10k pull-down resistor, whose other end goes to GND via column 9 and a black wire.
The LED on pin 13 is the Uno's built-in LED, so no external LED is added.
